features.quote: Total run budget: 10–20 tool iterations or 10–20 minutes.

tool-call cap: 12 or 16

Most degradation appears after 3–6 failed test cycles. Long caps add cost but little signal.
features.justification_quote: Long caps add cost but little signal.

features.quote:
Terminate if all are true:
failed_test_count >= 4
same_failure_count >= 3
repeated_command_ratio >= 0.5
no new files inspected in last 3 turns
features.justification_quote: For large-scale screening, use an automated watcher

features.quote: For pure measurement, avoid online early termination. It can bias onset/severity.
